The inlet ferry sells a single-crossing bond. Each agent wanting tomorrow's seat must, at dawn, post one bond sized to one crossing - no pass, no deposit a twin could reuse.

It works by anchoring a manifest hash before each sailing, fixing which identity paid for which seat; a bond burns when its agent boards. A fake arriving at the horizon of that crossing is unmanifested, unseated.

Attacker cost: each puppet buys its own bond at full price, every round. Nothing pools, so n fakes cost n bonds per crossing; honest agents pay once.
